يغتابون (form VIII)
# يَغْتَابُونَ (yaḡtābūna) /jaɣ.taː.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَابَ (iḡtāba)
# يُغْتَابُونَ (yuḡtābūna) /juɣ.taː.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَابَ (iḡtāba)
